title.value: VideoHandles: Editing 3D Object Compositions in Videos Using Video Generative Priors

TLDR.value: We propose a method for editing 3D object compositions in videos of static scenes with camera motion using video generative model priors.

abstract.value: We thank the reviewers for their valuable comments. After careful consideration, we think our paper is inappropriate for ICLR and decided to withdraw our paper.
